name: Bitpanda
verdict: Privately held European crypto-investing platform (Vienna-founded, Swiss holding). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Bitpanda is the brand of privately held Bitpanda Group AG (registered Zurich, founded Vienna 2014). Its founders and venture investors (Valar Ventures, DST Global partners, Peter Thiel) hold it; no source names a state or state-fund shareholder, and no human-rights finding against the company by a court, regulator, UN body or major NGO was found. A Frankfurt IPO was reported as planned for 2026 — worth revisiting once the shareholding structure is public. Bitpanda's own BaFin/FMA licences and MiCA registration are financial-regulatory matters and do not count under METHOD.md.
